attchmntText: KSR Footwear Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: KSR Footwear Limited has filed an intimation under Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Regulations regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements. The advertisements were published on November 14, 2026, in the Mint newspaper in all English editions and in the Aajkal newspaper in Bengali. These publications pertain to the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The filing was submitted to the Department of Corporate Services at BSE Limited with Scrip Code 544615 and to the Listing Department at the National Stock Exchange of India Limited with Symbol KSR. The document was signed by Shikha Jindal, Company Secretary, with ICSI Membership Number A58192.

attchmntText: KSR Footwear Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: KSR Footwear Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 509.90 million for the quarter and Rs. 1,012.40 million for the half year. Profit before tax was Rs. 3.96 million for the quarter and Rs. 4.21 million for the half year. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/s. Agarwal & Associates. The results are available on the company website and stock exchanges.
